notes:
Lead: Liam Morgan (AE) / SE: Priya Nair / CSM: Marco Ruiz.

Background:
- Arcadia Global Reinsurance is evaluating a Private VPC deployment for inference across multiple regions with strict data residency controls. Primary driver: regulatory & client contractual requirements for underwriting data to remain in-region (UK, EU, CA, APAC).
- Use-cases prioritized: automated claims triage (low-latency chat for adjusters), policy document ingestion and summarization, risk scoring for reinsurance underwriting, and agent assist for broker portals.

Security & technical requirements discussed:
- Must support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS + CloudHSM / Azure Key Vault + HSM) and option for on-prem HSM for certain clients.
- Audit logging: immutable audit trail with retention policy (7 years for some lines of business). Logs must be exportable to Splunk/Datadog/SIEM, with real-time alerts for anomalous access.
- Data residency: ability to enforce EU-only tenancy (for EU subsidiaries), separate UK residency for Lloyd's-related accounts, and Canadian residency for P&C business in Ontario/Quebec. APAC pilots planned in SG and AU.
- Networking: VPC peering or PrivateLink-style connectivity into Arcadia network; egress controls to block model telemetry; allow only approved outbound endpoints.
- Authentication & provisioning: SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, RBAC for model/prompts, token auditing down to caller.
- Model routing/fallback: prefer on-prem or regionally pinned model for sensitive flows; acceptable fallback to Redwood hosted non-sensitive endpoints only after explicit approvals.
- Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 required; additional legal addendum for data residency and breach notifications.

Recent timeline / activity:
- 2026-01-28: Initial intro (Liam) — high-level requirements capture.
- 2026-02-05: Technical deep-dive with infra + security (Priya) — discussed KMS & network controls; asked for network diagrams.
- 2026-02-18: Security questionnaire sent (v1) via Drive link.
- 2026-03-02: PoC kickoff call (ff_20260302_ArcadiaPOC). Agreed scope: EU-only VPC PoC for claims triage + audit logging export to Splunk.
- 2026-03-09: Internal legal flagged SLA language around cross-border subprocessors; asked Redwood for vendor list and subprocessor locations. Ticket opened: SEC-1773.
- 2026-03-10: Infra asked for sample KMS integration steps and HSM compatibility matrix (INF-4321). SE to schedule hands-on workshop.

Client quotes / color:

Technical POC scope (agreed):
- Deploy Redwood Private control plane in Arcadia VPC in eu-west-1 (EU-only) with dedicated inference nodes pinned to region.
- Integrate Arcadia AWS KMS key for envelope encryption; test with CloudHSM-backed key.
- Export audit logs to Arcadia Splunk project; validate retention and immutability claims.
- Validate SCIM user provisioning and SSO via Arcadia Okta tenant.
- Measure latency to meet 150-200ms 95th pctl for interactive adjuster flows; throughput target ~200 QPS for peak batch ingestion.
